ChatMessage.description:
One ordered conversation entry, including content, attachments, and
completion.
ChatMessage.usage: Import ChatMessage from @frame/core/modules/chat. The definition below is the source contract; optional fields may be omitted.

properties.name: id
properties.description:
Stable identity used to address this entry within its owning message or
schema.

properties.name: role
properties.description: Conversation role identifying the entry as user or assistant content.

properties.name: createdAt
properties.description: Creation timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

properties.name: parts
properties.description: Content parts retained in their original event order.

properties.name: attachments
properties.description: Host-selected attachment references associated with this entry or request.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Whether the entry is pending, complete, stopped, or failed.

properties.name: finishedAt
properties.description: Completion timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, when finished.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Failure explanation retained when the message finishes with an error.
